name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer based in Reno, Nevada, focused on gold properties in the state of Nevada. The company's flagship asset is the Lapon Canyon Gold Project in Mineral County, which hosts historical high-grade gold mining with approximately 2,000 feet of legacy underground workings. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage with an active drill program targeting high-grade gold at Lapon Canyon.
